title.zh: 宣布某些建筑材料短缺并授权菲律宾总统降低此类建筑材料关税税率的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring Shortages in Certain Construction Materials and Authorizing the President of the Philippines to Reduce Tariff Rates for Such Construction Materials
title.orig: An Act Declaring Shortages in Certain Construction Materials and Authorizing the President of the Philippines to Reduce Tariff Rates for Such Construction Materials

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1490_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
In view of the shortage of the materials hereinafter specified, the President of the Philippines, upon prior investigation by and recommendation of the National Economic Council, which shall conduct public hearings to determine the acuteness of the shortage demanding the reduction considering public interest, is hereby authorized to reduce the present rates of tariff duty provided under existing law by not more than the corresponding percentage as follows:
"1. Cement 70%
2. Steel, reinforcing and structural 75%
3. Asphalt 100%
4. G.I. sheets and building hardwares 75%
5. Pipes and plumbing materials 75%
6. Electric wires 75%
The authority herein granted and the rates as reduced by the President under the authority of this Act shall terminate upon the enactment of a new tariff law.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1956.
